title: DDL and DML
overview: A focused revision guide to ddl and dml.

sections.title: Key SQL statements
content: GROUP BY groups rows for aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG) — any non-aggregated column in SELECT must also appear in GROUP BY.

examples.label: Formula
examples.content: SELECT column1, column2 FROM table WHERE condition ORDER BY column1;

examples.label: Formula
examples.content: SELECT a.name, b.total FROM CustomersA a JOIN OrdersB b ON a.id = b.cust_id;
